Dependency, Concentration and External Reliance Management

clusters.name: Direction and subject
clusters.rationale: Separate governance and decision rights from the capability being assured.

clusters.name: Dependency and place
clusters.rationale: Make hidden reliance and physical boundary explicit.

clusters.name: Facility engineering
clusters.rationale: Different mechanisms, expertise, telemetry and failure modes.

clusters.name: AI technology chain
clusters.rationale: Distinct but tightly coupled compute, data and communication functions.

clusters.name: Operation and recovery
clusters.rationale: Separate routine control from continuity, crisis and restoration.

clusters.name: Ecosystem and authority
clusters.rationale: Separate supplier/lifecycle reliance from digital and OT authority.

clusters.name: Assurance integrity
clusters.rationale: Independently govern evidence, assessment, gates and decision integrity.

gates.name: Capability and outcome definition
gates.scope: Capability Instance, Service Outcomes, tolerances, criticality and decision question are defined, owned and approved
gates.failCeiling: INCONCLUSIVE for the whole decision: the top claim cannot be framed. The assessment returns to planning (AIDCF-009 DT-02) and no outcome-level decision is issued.
gates.unknownCeiling: INCONCLUSIVE for each Service Outcome whose definition or tolerance is UNKNOWN (US5); the remaining outcomes are capped at LIMITED.

gates.name: Boundary and architecture integrity
gates.scope: Assessment boundary, current architecture, as-built reconciliation and exclusions
gates.failCeiling: If the boundary itself cannot be established: INCONCLUSIVE for the whole decision. If reconciliation demonstrates material divergence in part of the architecture: NOT_ASSURED for claims about the unreconciled systems and LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
gates.unknownCeiling: LIMITED. Claims about systems whose reconciliation is incomplete are restricted to the DESIGN claim type.

gates.name: Critical dependency visibility
gates.scope: Material internal and external dependencies, common-mode exposure and concentration are identified and owned
gates.failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for every Service Outcome whose redundancy or independence claim is defeated by the identified common mode; LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
gates.unknownCeiling: LIMITED. RESILIENCE claims for the affected outcomes are INCONCLUSIVE.

gates.name: Life safety and hazardous energy
gates.scope: Fire, electrical arc-flash and shock, hazardous fluids and chemicals, confined space, refrigerants, battery thermal runaway and safe work
gates.failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for any claim relying on the affected area; all hazardous testing in the affected area is suspended; the duty holder is notified immediately (outside the decision process); LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
gates.unknownCeiling: LIMITED for outcomes depending on the affected area. No hazardous test is authorised there until the gate is resolved, so EFFECTIVENESS and RESILIENCE claims that need such tests remain UNKNOWN.

gates.name: Resilient electrical supply
gates.scope: Utility, distribution, UPS/BESS, generation, fuel, protection and power quality sufficient for the Service Outcomes across operating states
gates.failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for every Service Outcome depending on the affected electrical path; LIMITED for the decision as a whole where unaffected paths remain.
gates.unknownCeiling: LIMITED for outcomes depending on electrical continuity; RESILIENCE claims depending on the affected path are INCONCLUSIVE.

gates.name: Thermal continuity
gates.scope: Heat-removal path (air, liquid, facility water, heat rejection) sufficient across operating states including transients
gates.failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for Service Outcomes served by the affected heat-removal path at the declared load.
gates.unknownCeiling: LIMITED for outcomes depending on the affected heat-removal path.

gates.name: Critical control-system integrity
gates.scope: BMS, EPMS, CDU, PLC/SCADA and automation function safely, fail safe, and are configured and governed
gates.failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for Service Outcomes depending on the affected automated function. Claims based on demonstrated manual operation may be assessed separately and support at most LIMITED.
gates.unknownCeiling: LIMITED for outcomes depending on the affected automation.

gates.name: Compute, storage and network functional integrity
gates.scope: Accelerators, storage and fabrics deliver the required function, performance and integrity
gates.failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for Service Outcomes delivered by the affected cluster, fabric or storage tier. Facility outcomes defined at the rack interface are unaffected.
gates.unknownCeiling: LIMITED for the Service Outcomes delivered by the affected cluster, fabric or storage tier.

gates.name: Failure containment
gates.scope: Fault domains, isolation and blast-radius limits prevent propagation beyond tolerance
gates.failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for RESILIENCE claims, and for any Service Outcome whose tolerance assumes the defeated containment; LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
gates.unknownCeiling: INCONCLUSIVE for RESILIENCE claims of the affected outcomes; LIMITED for the decision as a whole.

gates.name: Recovery readiness
gates.scope: Restoration of outcomes (power, cooling, compute, data and checkpoint, network, control plane) within tolerance is planned and tested
gates.failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for recovery outcomes and for RESILIENCE claims of the affected outcomes; LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
gates.unknownCeiling: LIMITED; recovery outcomes are INCONCLUSIVE. DESIGN claims about recovery may still be reported.

gates.name: Evidence sufficiency
gates.scope: Evidence for decisive claims meets the AIDCF-008 floors (meta-gate across all controls)
gates.failCeiling: INCONCLUSIVE for the whole decision. Any previously issued decision relying on the affected evidence is SUSPENDED, and the matter is escalated as an evidence nonconformance (AIDCF-008 §47).

gates.name: Critical UNKNOWN
gates.scope: No unresolved US4 or US5 UNKNOWN without disposition (meta-gate across all controls)
gates.failCeiling: INCONCLUSIVE for the whole decision; escalated as an evidence nonconformance (concealed UNKNOWN, AIDCF-008 §47).
gates.unknownCeiling: LIMITED; INCONCLUSIVE if any undispositioned UNKNOWN is US5.

gates.name: Responsibility and authority
gates.scope: Every critical function and dependency has an accountable owner and decision authority
gates.failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for OPERATION, EFFECTIVENESS and RESILIENCE claims about the unowned function or dependency; LIMITED for the decision as a whole. If GC-13-6 is not met, no decision advances beyond the RECOMMENDED lifecycle state.

gates.name: Change control
gates.scope: Material changes are controlled, impact-assessed and validated
gates.failCeiling: Affected evidence is invalidated (STALE, U3) and claims relying on the post-change state become UNKNOWN; any prior decision covering the affected scope is SUSPENDED; LIMITED for the decision as a whole, or NOT_ASSURED where the uncontrolled change is demonstrated to have defeated a safeguard.

gates.name: Integrated digital authority over infrastructure
gates.scope: Identity, privilege, remote access and control-plane reach over facility and AI infrastructure are bounded, monitored and recoverable
gates.failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for every Service Outcome reachable through the unbounded authority path; LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
gates.unknownCeiling: LIMITED; INCONCLUSIVE where the unverified authority reaches the scope of two or more other gates (US5).

decisionStates.meaning: Sufficient appropriate evidence supports the bounded top claim; all applicable gates PASS or APPROVED_NA; no undisposed US3 or higher UNKNOWN
Bounded top claim supported subject to named, owned, time-bound conditions; no gate FAIL or UNKNOWN
Some sub-claims supported; material limitations, a gate UNKNOWN, or a gate FAIL whose AIDCF-010 ceiling is LIMITED prevent a broader conclusion
Evidence, method, boundary or definition cannot support any determination
Evidence demonstrates that the top claim, or a controlling gate, is not met

chain.name: Decision Question
chain.question: What decision will rely on this assessment, and who will make it?

chain.name: Capability Instance
chain.question: Which bounded deployment is the subject?

chain.name: Service Outcome
chain.question: What must it achieve, within which tolerances?

chain.name: Required Function
chain.question: Which functions must be delivered for each outcome?

chain.name: Architecture
chain.question: Which systems, assets and interfaces implement each function, as built?

chain.name: Dependency and Fault Domain
chain.question: What does each element rely on, and what fails together?

chain.name: Threat / Hazard / Failure Scenario
chain.question: How can the outcome be defeated?

chain.name: Safeguard
chain.question: Which real measures prevent, detect, contain or recover?

chain.name: Control
chain.question: Which AIDCF requirements test those safeguards?

chain.name: Evidence Requirement
chain.question: What evidence would demonstrate each control at the required claim type?

chain.name: Control Assessment
chain.question: What result does the evidence support, for which claim type and scope?

chain.name: Finding / UNKNOWN Record
chain.question: What deficiencies and unresolved uncertainties remain?

chain.name: Score Snapshot and Decision Recommendation
chain.question: What do the results summarise to, and what does the engine recommend?

chain.name: Assurance Decision
chain.question: What has accountable authority decided, with which conditions and validity?

chain.name: Report and Reassessment Trigger
chain.question: How is the decision communicated, and what invalidates it?
